name.ja: 3次スプラインと形状保存補間

formula: S\in C^2\ \text{for the natural/clamped spline};\quad P\in C^1\ \text{for PCHIP}

note.ja: 端点条件を持つC2補間と単調な区分Hermite補間を区別します。
note.en: Distinguish C2 interpolation with endpoint conditions from monotone piecewise Hermite interpolation.

equation_note.ja: 実binary64の節点と値を使用。自然条件は両端2階微分ゼロ、clamped条件は入力端点1階微分です。
equation_note.en: Use actual binary64 knots and values. Natural conditions set both endpoint second derivatives to zero; clamped conditions prescribe the first derivatives from the input.

title.ja: 自然・端点微分指定スプラインとPCHIP
title.en: Natural and clamped splines versus PCHIP

assumptions.ja: 実binary64の節点と値を使用。自然条件は両端2階微分ゼロ、clamped条件は入力端点1階微分です。
assumptions.en: Use actual binary64 knots and values. Natural conditions set both endpoint second derivatives to zero; clamped conditions prescribe the first derivatives from the input.

note.ja: PCHIPは通常C1でありC2とは限りません。一般データの最良近似・外挿・ノイズ平滑化は対象外。SciPyは原著完全閲読の代用ではありません。
note.en: PCHIP is generally C1, not necessarily C2. Best approximation, extrapolation and noise smoothing are outside scope. A SciPy comparison does not substitute for reading the original papers.

reference_note.ja: 正確な有理2階微分系・有理PCHIP・SciPy 1.14.1を照合。端点15記録は16スカラー出力・13異なる入力。平坦部の負値は実binary64をFraction化した独立式で示します。
reference_note.en: Compare with exact rational second-derivative systems, rational PCHIP and SciPy 1.14.1. Fifteen endpoint records contain sixteen scalar outputs from thirteen distinct inputs. Independent Fraction formulas show plateau undershoot for the actual binary64 data.

method_note.ja: 3次Bスプラインの配置行列を解きde Boor評価。別経路でPCHIPの調和平均・端点制限とHermite評価を実装します。
method_note.en: Solve a cubic B-spline collocation system and evaluate it with de Boor recursion. A separate path implements PCHIP harmonic slopes, endpoint limiting and Hermite evaluation.
